purpose: Turn authoritative after-action journal/report data into a cooperative player-facing report without exposing internal formulas or assigning blame.

priority: earlier choice that materially changed the storm
delayed consequence physically experienced by players
unresolved condition that concretely cost something
exclude: minor resource deltas without visible consequence
raw internal tags as player-facing text
causalSelection.unknownCausePolicy: May display the effect, but do not invent a cause or expose an internal tag as explanation.

tags.TEAM_RISKY: I tog chancer for at komme fremad.
tags.TEAM_PROTECTED_CAMP: I holdt lejren samlet under pres.

teamStory.rule: Tags are narrative summaries, never competitive scores.

forbiddenPatterns: hidden technical attribution presented as blame

retryStorm.availability: only when checkpoint contract permits it

personalization.ordering: neutral rescue and optional personal message before detailed after-action report

humanAcceptance: players can explain at least one major cause before seeing the report
report matches the causal story players thought they experienced
loss gives a useful hypothesis for a different plan
report does not feel like blame or a competitive scoreboard
replay intent is not reduced by the report
handoff: Claude owns runtime view/layout, data binding, transition timing and headset readability. Product selection/framing rules remain ChatGPT-owned.
